$comment: Door animation spec. Model px, master local space (front at z=0, facing NORTH); rotate with the rack facing.
easing: smoothstep (t*t*(3-2t)) on open and close; interpolate with partialTick

front.note: hinged on the LEFT as seen from the front (+x side); negative = swings out toward -z (verified in previews/door_swing_frames.png); the leaf fills x 1.5..14.5, y -13..29 (between the posts, above the plinth)

rear_left.note: x 8..14.5, hinged on its outer edge; positive = swings out toward +z; the leaves sit at z 30.6..31.6 so their handles end at the z 32 model limit

rear_right.note: x 1.5..8, hinged on its outer edge; negative = swings out toward +z

close.at_tick: when the close animation starts (latch click is at the end of the clip, ~0.32 s in = tick 6-7, lining up with the swing)

rear_doors: both rear leaves open/close together from one right-click on the rear face
